test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:

The professor spoke so ___ that many students lost interest.
solution:
The correct answer is '**monotonously**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a word to modify the verb **"spoke."** Words that describe how an action is performed are **adverbs**.
 
• **"Monotonously"** is the adverb form of the word, meaning to speak in a dull, unvarying tone.
 
• The sentence follows the **"so + adverb + that"** structure, which is used to show cause and effect (the boring speech caused the students to lose interest).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The professor spoke so **monotonously**__ that many students lost interest."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "monotony"** is a **noun** referring to the state of being tedious or repetitive (e.g., "The monotony of the job was tiring").
 
• **Option 2: "monotonous"** is an **adjective**. It describes a noun, not a verb (e.g., "He has a monotonous voice").
 
• **Option 4: "monotonic"** is also an **adjective**, often used in technical, mathematical, or phonological contexts to describe a sequence that stays the same.
